evidence_policy.reference_agreement: Agreement with an independent table or equation at listed conditions only.
evidence_policy.numerical_study: Resolution sensitivity, not an experimental accuracy estimate.
evidence_policy.incompatible_reference: Inputs or model definitions differ. No pass or fail accuracy decision.
evidence_policy.validated_domain_rule: Only an explicitly reviewed intended-use dataset can create a validated domain. Never infer one from passing tests.
evidence_policy.calibration_rule: Calibration data cannot also serve as independent validation data.
